note: Busselton Motel (25-31 Bussell Hwy) sign, a low white board on two posts on the lawn at the motel's east corner, angled to the highway and the side street (Mapillary, Oct 2019; its top shows under the tree in the Landgate aerial, Oct 2026). Drawn about 2.7 m wide, its top 1.9 m up, lettered BUSSELTON MOTEL. Plain lettering only, in neutral colours (no logo, no brand colours). Metres: x across the sign face as seen by the traffic it faces, y back from the face.
